channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Ministro da Fazenda diz que EUA têm interesse político de ajudar família Bolsonaro, mas que pode debater com Trump etanol e big techs
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan said U.S. President Donald Trump has political interest in helping the Bolsonaro family, but Brazil can negotiate specific issues like ethanol and big tech regulation to avoid new tariffs. He dismissed Trump’s claims of political risk in Brazil, affirming institutional stability and free elections in 2026, unlike the alleged climate of 2022. Durigan also stressed that issues such as Pix and national sovereignty in combating organized crime and overseeing elections are non-negotiable.

item.title: Operação contra Jaques Wagner cria dois problemas para campanha de Lula
item.description: The Federal Police operation against Senator Jaques Wagner, a Lula ally, creates two problems for the president's re-election campaign: the risk of political damage through association with investigations and the potential distraction from the electoral agenda due to new corruption allegations.

item.title: Caiado afirma que Flávio Bolsonaro ‘perdeu a chance’ contra Lula
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado stated that Flávio Bolsonaro 'lost the chance' to defeat Lula in the 2026 elections, citing polls showing the senator's growing disadvantage in a potential runoff. The PSD pre-candidate positioned himself as a more viable alternative, claiming his own polling performance is more competitive against Lula, including a tie in one Quaest survey.

item.title: PF apura se Vorcaro deu apartamento de R$ 2,5 mi a Jaques Wagner
item.description: The Federal Police is investigating whether Banco Master founder Daniel Vorcaro gifted a R$2.5 million apartment to Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), along with payments to Bonnie Bonilha, the senator's stepdaughter's wife, via a consultancy. The probe is part of the 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero, involving 18 search warrants in Bahia, São Paulo, and the Federal District, authorized by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça.

item.title: Gracinha Caiado lidera disputa ao Senado em Goiás, diz pesquisa
item.description: The Exata.GO poll, conducted from June 8 to 13, 2026, shows Gracinha Caiado (União Brasil), former first lady of Goiás, leading the race for one of Goiás’ two Senate seats, with federal deputy Gustavo Gayer (PL) in second place. The survey interviewed 3,600 voters, has a 95% confidence level and a margin of error of ±1.63 percentage points, and is registered with the TSE under code GO-07683/2026. Voters will elect two senators in the October elections.

item.title: TSE volta a permitir sustentações orais em julgamentos de referendos e liminares
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques reinstated the possibility of oral arguments by lawyers in judgments involving the appeal of provisional measures and urgent injunctions, limited to five minutes per attorney. The decision was unanimously approved by the Court’s Plenary in a session held on Tuesday (9), restoring a historical tradition of Electoral Justice.

item.title: Os limites impostos por Mendonça ao líder do governo Lula
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça barred Senate government leader Jaques Wagner from contacting other suspects in the ninth phase of Operation Compliance Zero. He also prohibited Wagner from engaging in management or business activities with the companies named in the complaint. The restriction aims to prevent interference in ongoing investigations.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Lula tem posição eleitoral confortável, mas chega perto do ‘teto’
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva holds a comfortable electoral position for 2026, with approval ratings surpassing disapproval in most polls, bolstered by setbacks for his main rival Flávio Bolsonaro and government delivery of infrastructure and social programs. However, analysts suggest his support may be nearing a ceiling, with limited room for further significant gains. The administration also faces fallout from the Vorcaro-linked scandal, including investigations targeting allies like Jaques Wagner and a court-ordered suspension of social media ads on ending the 6×1 workweek.

item.title: Mendonça negou pedido da PF por buscas contra Jaques no Senado
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça denied the Federal Police's request to conduct searches in Senator Jaques Wagner’s (PT-BA) Senate office, authorizing only searches at his personal addresses, such as a hotel in Brasília. The ruling aligned with the PGR, which argued that searches in Congress require particularly rigorous justification and were not warranted at this stage of the investigation. Wagner is suspected of receiving a luxury property and bribe payments tied to the Master operation, while police also executed warrants against Augusto Lima, former Vorcaro partner and former implementer of Bahia’s payroll credit scheme linked to Banco Master.

item.title: Entidades pedem manutenção de veto em Estatuto da Segurança Privada
item.description: Private security associations are urging the preservation of the presidential veto on the Private Security Statute, warning that its overturn could increase market concentration, distort competition, and raise operational costs. They argue the veto safeguards free competition, economic freedom, and legal certainty in a strategically important sector for Brazil's economy.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Nova pesquisa Datafolha testa força de Lula e Flávio | #OP News
item.description: A new Datafolha poll tests the electoral strength of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 elections. The survey takes place amid a polarized political climate and debates over Brazil’s future leadership. No specific results from the poll are mentioned in the provided content.

item.title: Caso Master atinge ‘galego’ de Lula e desidrata discurso do PT contra opositores
item.description: The 9th phase of Operation Compliance Zero investiges Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), a close ally of Lula, for allegedly receiving undue advantages tied to the scheme of banker Daniel Vorcaro, including luxury property deals in Salvador and kickbacks via a relative’s company. Wagner, as Bahia’s Secretary of Economic Development in 2017, enabled Master’s monopoly over the CredCesta program, expanding Vorcaro’s influence statewide. Investigators fear the case may drag beyond the 2026 elections and be abandoned, which would be a mockery and demoralize the Federal Police.

item.title: Líder do governo Lula é alvo de busca e apreensão em operação sobre Master, diz fonte
item.description: The leader of Lula's government in the Senate, Jaques Wagner (PT-BA), is the target of a search and seizure operation under Compliance Zero, related to Banco Master, according to a PF source. The action took place on Thursday as part of a new phase of the investigation.

item.title: Flávio anuncia pacote para segurança pública com castração química e aumento de vagas em presídios
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, pre-candidate for presidency, announced a 12-point public security package that includes increasing federal prison capacity, creating new state penitentiary units, and implementing chemical castration for sexual offenders, inspired by El Salvador’s policies. The plan also proposes using electronic ankle monitors to track aggressors of women, allowing victims to monitor their location via app and alert monitoring centers if proximity rules are violated. The measures aim to harden the fight against organized crime while positioning the candidate as a defender of women, in contrast to Lula’s anti-femicide campaign.

item.title: Em ano de eleição, Lula acumula 20 dias fora do Brasil
item.description: President Lula has spent 20 days abroad in 2026 across six international trips, visiting France, the U.S., India, South Korea, UAE, Spain, Germany, Portugal, Panama, and Colombia. His agenda emphasized multilateralism, criticized protectionism and big tech, and included trade talks with the U.S., though a planned bilateral meeting with Trump at the G7 did not occur. The frequency of his international travel is lower than in the early years of his presidency.

item.title: Janja acumula 25 dias fora do Brasil em 2026
item.description: First Lady Janja da Silva spent 25 days abroad in 2026, surpassing President Lula’s 20 days, after five international trips that included UN events, the G7 summit, business forums, and agendas focused on women’s rights, food security, and human rights. She represented Brazil alone in the U.S., Italy, and South Korea/UAE, and accompanied Lula on a European tour. Since the start of Lula’s third term, Janja has accumulated 182 days abroad, compared to Lula’s 158.

item.title: Entenda a regulamentação das big techs definida pelo STF
item.description: The STF finalized the regulation of big tech platforms in Brazil, requiring companies like Facebook, Instagram, X, and YouTube to remove illegal content — including terrorism, discrimination, child pornography, and antidemocratic acts such as coups and election sabotage — within 60 days. Platforms must now maintain legal addresses in Brazil and uphold ongoing structural duties to monitor content, while private communications like email and instant messaging remain protected by communication secrecy.

item.title: Lula aumenta tamanho do Bolsa Família em ano eleitoral
item.description: In June 2026, the Bolsa Família program increased to 19.35 million beneficiary families, with an average benefit of R$677.66, following the addition of 690,000 new households since November 2025. The rise occurs during an election year despite low unemployment and rising household incomes, continuing a historical trend of program expansion in election years (except 2014). Monthly program costs rose to R$13.1 billion, reflecting post-2025 audit expansion after removing 2.1 million beneficiaries due to fraud.

item.title: Lula passou 158 dias fora do Brasil no 3º mandato
item.description: Lula spent 158 days abroad during his third term, with 46 trips to 41 countries. In 2026 alone, he has accumulated 20 days across six international trips, including the G7 summit in France and bilateral meetings with leaders such as Macron and Trump. His highest absence was in 2023 (62 days), dropping to 26 days in 2024 due to head surgery.

item.title: Entre farpas e diplomacia: o saldo de Lula no G7 com Trump, UE e Ucrânia
item.description: Lula attended the G7 summit in France, holding bilateral meetings with leaders including Trump, Zelensky, and EU representatives, but later engaged in a public exchange of criticism with the U.S. president. After an initially cordial interaction where Trump praised Lula’s 'good work,' the two traded barbs, with Trump calling Brazil 'politically difficult' and Lula accusing him of behaving like an 'emperor' and interfering in Brazilian elections. Brazil endorsed only three of the eight G7 statements, signaling diplomatic distance, according to government sources.

item.title: Justiça da Flórida usa método Moraes para citar ministro em ação do Rumble e Trump Media
item.description: The Florida court used the same citation method that Justice Alexandre de Moraes previously applied in a case against Eduardo Bolsonaro to serve him in the lawsuit filed by Rumble and Trump Media. The method, originally employed by Moraes to interfere in investigations related to the coup plot and impose sanctions on Brazilian authorities in the U.S., is now being turned against him. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: CNI alerta presidenciáveis sobre crise no transporte e aponta soluções
item.description: The CNI warns presidential candidates about a logistics and infrastructure crisis in Brazil’s freight transport, noting that 38.4% of the national rail network is inactive and overreliance on roads increases costs and reduces efficiency. It proposes reactivating idle rail sections, finalizing the Rail Legal Framework, and improving public sector coordination to modernize the country’s transport matrix.

item.title: Lula retorna a Brasília sob pressão do tarifaço e impasse no Congresso
item.description: Lula returns to Brasília after a G7 trip, facing pressure from stalled congressional priorities, electoral alliances, and the threat of U.S. tariffs on Brazilian exports that could reach 37.5%. Trump made controversial and confused remarks about Brazil, including mistakenly referring to Eduardo Bolsonaro as Flávio Bolsonaro and commenting on the country's political climate. The Brazilian government considers it difficult to reverse a proposed 12.5% tariff linked to forced labor, with 59 other countries also under investigation by the USTR.

item.title: Gilmar Mendes expõe racha e atitude suspeita sobre Master
item.description: Gilmar Mendes revealed public disagreements with André Mendonça regarding the arrest of Daniel Vorcaro's father, exposing internal rifts in the Supreme Federal Court and reigniting suspicions about judicial conduct in the Master case. The Court's dean emerged negatively from the episode, with his reputation damaged.

item.title: BSB Grill se transforma no Point do Torcedor em Brasília
item.description: BSB Grill, a premium meat restaurant in Brasília’s 413 Sul, has become the official 'Fan Point' of Guaraná Antarctica for the 2026 major sporting event, featuring themed decor, promotional combos like picanha skewer with guaraná and double Brahma beer, a photo booth, live music, and a kids' playground. The initiative is part of the national campaign 'Sede de Torcer É Coisa Nossa', uniting fans of the Brazilian national team across cities including Brasília, Recife, Goiânia, Belo Horizonte, Fortaleza, Curitiba, Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.

item.title: 'Eu nunca fui esquerdista', diz Lula em conversa informal com chanceler alemão e diretora do FMI no G7
item.description: Lula stated in an informally recorded conversation at the G7 in France that he was never a leftist but always a union leader, emphasizing strong ties with German, Italian, and Spain’s UGT unions. He also defended Brazil’s auditable electronic voting system as a model for other nations and recalled being labeled an 'anticommunist' in the 1980s after being barred from traveling to Russia under Brazil’s National Security Law.

item.title: Caso Master: o passado e o futuro da investigação - O Assunto #1742
item.description: The Second Chamber of the STF upheld the preventive detention of Daniel Vorcaro's father and cousin in the Master Case, with Gilmar Mendes casting the sole dissenting vote, comparing the investigation to Operation Car Wash. Reporter André Mendonça, the case's rapporteur, lifted the seal on new findings implicating major political figures and warned that 'more is coming'. Journalist Consuelo Dieguez outlines the scandal's timeline, key players, and potential investigative paths forward.

item.title: Com ressalvas, TCE-SP aprova contas de 2025 do governo Tarcísio
item.description: The São Paulo State Court of Accounts (TCE-SP) unanimously approved the 2025 accounts of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, but with reservations regarding financial statements, pension management, and revenue renunciations. The rapporteur criticized the secrecy around tax waivers and deficiencies in overseeing privatized highway contracts and socially managed hospitals, calling for stronger state oversight.

item.title: Atitude de Eduardo Bolsonaro causa problema político para a cúpula do PL
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro's insistence on remaining as Senate substitute on the PL's ticket in São Paulo has created an internal impasse, as his STF conviction for attempting to interfere in the coup plot trial has turned him into a political liability for the party. Despite pressure from party leaders for him to step aside voluntarily, Eduardo has refused to back down, leaving the PL without a clear solution to avoid electoral damage and direct association with his controversial figure during the campaign.

item.title: Nunes Marques será o relator de ação de Flávio contra Lula por ameaça e incitação ao crime
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Kassio Nunes Marques has been randomly assigned as the rapporteur of a criminal complaint filed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro against President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, alleging threats and incitement to crime. The complaint stems from public statements made by Lula that Bolsonaro interprets as a direct threat.

item.title: Câmara aprova 'jabuti' que anistia caminhoneiros de bloqueios bolsonaristas em MP do Frete
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved the Freight Provisional Measure, which includes a 'jabuti' granting amnesty for judicial, administrative, and civil fines imposed on truckers and transporters who participated in highway blockades after the 2022 elections. The text, sent by the Lula government to reinforce the minimum wage for road transport, will now proceed to the Senate for review.

item.title: Pesquisas: a novidade que pode favorecer Lula na disputa contra Flávio
item.description: The public exchange of criticisms between Lula and Trump may favor the Brazilian president by linking the issue to national sovereignty defense, according to Murilo Hidalgo of Instituto Paraná Pesquisas. Eduardo Bolsonaro's conviction could strengthen the government's narrative, while Flávio Bolsonaro urgently needs to shift his agenda to regain political relevance.

item.title: Lula reclama com equipe por chegar cedo à reunião do G7
item.description: President Lula was caught on audio reprimanding his team for making him arrive early to a G7 meeting in France, saying he was 'angry' about the situation. He stated he prefers to come down only when the meeting is nearly ready to avoid unnecessary waiting. The incident occurred during the G7 summit in Évian on Wednesday, July 17.

item.title: Hugo Motta quer normalizar a corrupção
item.description: Hugo Motta, president of the Chamber of Deputies, was criticized for normalizing corruption after justifying receiving luxury hotel payments abroad from banker Daniel Vorcaro. The article argues such acts are incompatible with public office and that Brazil’s impunity encourages this behavior, though it suggests Vorcaro may face legal consequences if he does not make a full and deep plea bargain.

item.title: TCU lançará painel para rastrear emendas em 1º de julho
item.description: TCU President Vital do Rêgo Filho announced that on July 1, 2026, a digital dashboard will be launched to track the execution of parliamentary amendments from congressional approval to final project verification. Developed in partnership with Congress and the office of STF Minister Flávio Dino, the tool aims to enhance transparency and oversight of public funds by integrating databases to monitor each budgetary stage.

item.title: “Acho que a condenação foi injusta”, diz Tarcísio sobre Eduardo
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) called the conviction of former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) for coercion unjust, though he stated that the Supreme Federal Court’s decision does not jeopardize his political group’s electoral plans.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro pede novas sanções de Trump a Moraes
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro urged U.S. President Donald Trump to reimpose sanctions on Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, calling him a human rights violator and declaring the legal process against him null. He claims he is being politically persecuted and that his conviction for coercion in the Bolsonaro case is unjust. Eduardo has been in the U.S. since February 2025, lost his congressional mandate in December 2025, and was sentenced to 4 years and 2 months in prison plus a fine of R$162,100.

item.title: Trump critica política do Brasil e confunde Bolsonaros após G7
item.description: At the G7 summit in France, Donald Trump criticized Brazil's political situation as 'politically difficult' and 'dangerous,' while mixing up details about the sons of former president Jair Bolsonaro, confusing Eduardo and Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula rebutted Trump's remarks, emphasizing the civility of Brazilian elections and rejecting foreign interference. Trump confirmed only the meeting with Lula, without elaborating on topics such as tariffs or the designation of criminal groups as terrorist organizations.

item.title: TCE aprova contas de Tarcísio, mas relator cita 'orçamento paralelo' de isenções fiscais
item.description: The São Paulo State Court of Accounts approved the 2025 accounts of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, but the rapporteur highlighted the existence of a 'parallel budget' created through tax exemptions, issuing several reservations about fiscal management.

item.title: G7: Lula é flagrado dando bronca em Mauro Vieira por chegar cedo a reunião
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was caught on audio complaining to Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira that the Brazilian delegation arrived too early for a G7 meeting in France, saying they should have waited until nearly the start of the session. Despite this, Lula had a brief and cordial encounter with Donald Trump on the sidelines of the summit, marked by Trump asking how he was and wishing him 'good work,' after the two did not interact during the official leaders' photo due to separate engagements.

item.title: Câmara aprova anistia a caminhoneiros que bloquearam estradas após derrota de Bolsonaro
item.description: The Chamber approved, in a symbolic vote, the Freight MP with alterations to the original text from President Lula's government, including a 'jabuti' that grants amnesty to truckers who blocked highways after Bolsonaro's 2022 defeat. The measure also tightens cargo transport rules and enforces the wage floor for the category.

item.title: Lula diz à diretora-geral do FMI que nunca foi esquerdista
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated in an informal conversation during the G7 summit in France that he never considered himself 'a leftist'. The remark was made to IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva and the German Chancellor while discussing the global political landscape. The comment was picked up by microphones and reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: Partidos pressionam TSE por mudanças em regras de campanha
item.description: Party leaders met with the president of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, to push for changes in campaign rules that would allow mass messaging via apps during elections. The proposal, already approved by the Chamber of Deputies, awaits Senate vote. The meeting aims to secure institutional support for the measure, which could influence the dynamics of the 2026 electoral campaigns.

item.title: Segurança Pública no Brasil: Custos do Crime e Mudança de Valores - Romeu Zema | Papo de Elite #014
item.description: The video analyzes the economic impact of crime in Brazil, highlighting the social and financial costs of violence, and proposes a shift in values as a path to improve public security. Romeu Zema, governor of Minas Gerais, is cited as an example of leadership that prioritizes security policies focused on prevention and efficiency.

item.title: Falta ao Brasil uma estratégia para lidar com a doutrina Donroe
item.description: Brazil lacks a clear strategy to confront the Monroe Doctrine — referred to in the text as 'Donroe' — which asserts U.S. dominance over the Western Hemisphere through economic, financial, technological, and military coercion. Both Bolsonaro allies and Lula mistakenly believe Trump will aid them in the 2026 elections, but the U.S. president treats all Brazilian actors indifferently, viewing Brazil as merely part of America's strategic backyard. The real dilemma for Brazil is defining its global role: to become a neutral, resource-rich middle power, it needs strategic intelligence and internal cohesion, which have been absent for decades.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro pede retomada de sanções contra Moraes um dia após condenação no STF
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro urged U.S. President Donald Trump to reinstate sanctions against Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, one day after being convicted in the coup plot case. He was sentenced to four years and two months in semi-open prison and fined R$165,000 for coercion. The request aims to pressure Brazil's judiciary through foreign influence.

item.title: G7: Macron celebra 'gol' para a Ucrânia, mas Lula sai insatisfeito com resultado da cúpula
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron celebrated the G7 summit outcome in Évian as a 'goal' for Ukraine, emphasizing renewed international support for the country in its conflict with Russia. Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, however, expressed dissatisfaction, criticizing the lack of progress on issues such as climate justice and reform of the global financial system, which he views as essential for Global South nations.

item.title: Nunes Marques será relator de ação de Flávio contra Lula
item.description: Minister Kassio Nunes Marques was randomly assigned by the STF as rapporteur of the criminal complaint filed by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro against President Lula, following Lula’s remarks calling Bolsonaro’s sons 'traitors of the homeland' and likening them to Joaquim Silvério dos Reis, the informant in the Inconfidência Mineira. Flávio’s defense claims Lula incited homicide by hanging. The electronic draw took place on May 17, 2026.

item.title: Empatados em pesquisa para presidência, Renan Santos e Caiado focam em reduzir desconhecimento
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) are tied at 3% voting intention in the latest Quaest poll, but face high levels of voter unfamiliarity — 70% and 48%, respectively. Both are working to increase visibility through social media, nationwide travel, and investor events, while raising funds via a virtual crowdfunding campaign and the minimum electoral fund quota to bolster their 2026 presidential pre-campaigns.

item.title: Câmara aprova MP sobre piso do frete e inclui anistia a multas por bloqueio de estradas
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved Provisional Measure 1343/26, which changes road cargo transport rules to reinforce the minimum freight floor and includes amnesty for fines imposed on transporters and drivers involved in road blockades after the 2022 elections. Rapporteur Deputy Zé Trovão (PL-SC) defended the measure as a way to give dignity to autonomous truckers, while the opposition criticized poor federal highway infrastructure and excessive radar use. The text will now be sent to the Senate.
